# BeagleBone Black processor pin fonts

These fixtures contain U5's complete visible processor units from sheets P03
and P04 of the BeagleBone Black A5B Altium reference used by the Sitara demo.
Component geometry, source ports, pin names, font sizes and port positions are
unchanged from `altium-to-circuit-json` conversion with a 0.01 schematic scale.
Only the authored `Times New Roman` family is supplied on the visible labels;
the source sheet selects it with `SYSTEMFONT=1` and `FONTNAME1=Times New Roman`.

Reference: https://github.com/Circuitco/-BeagleBone-Black-RevA5/blob/master/BeagleBoardBlack_RevA5_Altium.zip

Archive SHA-256: `7ff2ca881779f51b9fcb83e041bd06125fc2cb91ba5111c8d360b9df1a651413`.
The sheets are inside the nested `BeagleBoneBlackB3_Altium.zip` archive.

The snapshots show the real processor units rather than a synthetic long label.
Each pin retains its source identity and complete multiplexed name.
